description: Decode the vocabularies the other iNaturalist tools take as input: annotation attributes and values, quality grades, license codes, taxonomic ranks, iconic taxa, and IUCN conservation-status codes. An unrecognized filter value is not rejected upstream — it silently returns nothing — so read the codes here before filtering. Note that the conservation codes are the normalised csi search filter; a taxon record’s own conservation_statuses[].status is authority-specific free text and reads differently. With topic controlled_terms and a taxon_id, the response also carries which annotations identifiers have actually recorded for that taxon, with counts.

taxon_id.description: Add observed annotation usage for this taxon, ranked by how often each attribute/value pair has been recorded. Valid only with topic controlled_terms. Resolve a name to an id with inaturalist_resolve_name.

topic.description: Which vocabulary to decode. controlled_terms is fetched live and cached; the rest are spec-derived static tables.

name: inaturalist_list_reference

entries.description: The vocabulary, one entry per code or attribute.

items.description: One vocabulary entry — an annotation attribute, or a static filter code.

code.description: The literal filter value to pass, on the static topics — e.g. "needs_id", "cc0", "Aves".

id.description: Numeric attribute id, on the controlled_terms topic. Pass it as term_id.

multivalued.description: True when one observation may carry several values of this attribute.

notes.description: What the entry means, or how it is used, when it needs saying.

values.description: Values this annotation attribute accepts, on the controlled_terms topic.

items.description: One value of an annotation attribute.

blocking.description: True when this value blocks other values of the same attribute.

id.description: Value id. Pass it as term_value_id alongside the attribute id.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `taxon_id_not_applicable`: taxon_id was supplied with a topic other than controlled_terms. `unknown_taxon_id`: iNaturalist answered 422 because the taxon_id does not exist. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Guidance when the requested taxon has no recorded annotations yet.

observed_usage.description: Observed annotation usage for taxon_id, most-used first. Present only when taxon_id was given.

items.description: One attribute/value pair and how often it has been recorded.

count.description: How many observations of this taxon carry the pair.

term_id.description: Attribute id — pass it as term_id to filter search, species counts, or the histogram. Null when upstream omitted it.

term_value_id.description: Value id — pass it as term_value_id alongside term_id. Null when upstream omitted it.

value.description: Annotation value label. Labels repeat across attributes, so filter by the ids rather than the label.

source.description: "upstream" when the table was fetched from iNaturalist, "static" when spec-derived.

title: Inaturalist List Reference
